claims: Japan defeated Cuba to win the 2006 World Baseball Classic.
Japan defeated South Korea to win the 2009 World Baseball Classic.
Dominican Republic defeated Puerto Rico to win the 2013 World Baseball Classic.
United States defeated Puerto Rico to win the 2017 World Baseball Classic.
Japan defeated the United States to win the 2023 World Baseball Classic.
Venezuela defeated the United States to win the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Japan won three of the first five World Baseball Classic tournaments in 2006, 2009, and 2023.
